title: Edit the Notes of existing text segments
description: Stages, in bulk, the replacement of the Notes of segments in existing Texts: each edit names a Text, a segment or a word in it, and the one Note the segment is to hold. Apply refuses a segment whose Notes, in any writing system, changed since the edit was composed. Other Notes of the segment are removed. Give one intent with many edits, or --notes-tsv, never one intent per edit. A Trial reparses nothing of the grammar. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
usage: Usage: motif compose-edit-text-notes --draft <name> --project <fwdata> --intent '<closed intent JSON>', or --notes-tsv <file> [--analysis-ws <tag>] in place of --intent [--cite-source <text> [--cite-locator <text>]]
